# Harden the moth-ledger hosts

One playbook, `playbook.yml`; the templates and files it refers to exist in the repository (names in `PLAYBOOK_RULES.md`). Rules: `PLAYBOOK_RULES.md`.
start.playbook.yml:
---
- name: Harden the moth-ledger hosts
  hosts: ledger
  become: true
  vars:
    ssh_port: 2222
    allowed_users:
      - ops
      - audit
    banner_text: Authorised use only
  tasks:
    - name: Install fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: fail2ban
        state: present
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
    - name: Install fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: sshd_hardening.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-hardening.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0600"
      notify: Restart sshd
    - name: Write the login banner
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: |
          {{ banner_text }}
        dest: /etc/issue.net
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
    - name: Lock the unused accounts
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        password_lock: true
      loop:
        - games
        - news
        - uucp
    - name: Enable and start fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: fail2ban
        state: started
        enabled: true
      when: "{{ ansible_os_family == 'Debian' }}"
  handlers:
    - name: Restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: ssh
        state: restarted
